predict.question: In your notes app, a starting note links to two new notes, and each of those does the same. Following three hops, with no repeats and a 12-note cap, how many notes, counting the start?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: How to Take Smart Notes emphasizes meaningful connections between notes rather than collection alone.
modelBoundary: One hop reaches {A}; three hops {B}. Deeper traversal accesses notes absent from the immediate neighborhood.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? A tree of reachable notes says nothing about the quality of their connections.
